variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: The company {company} has laid off many workers. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.body: Many workers have been laid off by {company}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
